articles.summary: Typhoon Bavi struck the Philippines on 12 April 2026, killing 18 people and leaving 12 missing in the Visayas region. The Philippine National Police reported the casualties after heavy rains and flooding in Iloilo and Negros. In China, the Civil Aviation Administration ordered the evacuation of 2 million residents from coastal provinces, and more than 300 flights were canceled in Shanghai and Guangzhou. The storm, named Inday by local media, also halted daily life in Taiwan, where authorities suspended public transport and school operations.
